absence_basis: Full path census contains only declared regular audit/control files and recognized cache namespaces; no source-edit pending or staging metadata, no symlinks or special entries.
key_observation: path string in retained gate.meta only; credential file and contents were not read
recovery_limit: Cache payload hashes identify what would be discarded; they do not preserve bytes or attest HMAC validity. Rebuilding can repopulate useful cache state but is not an exact-byte recovery claim.

references.claim: --store is a disposable Directory; --store-key is a separate private 32-byte secret. Key remains outside every read grant.
Missing, special and unreadable entries are disposable misses.
